title: The organization part of a person's adaptation plan (DEC-0138)
description: What a person's Fabric sends an organization's server when the person brings work into that organization (OM-7's adaptation row, TP-03): the items the person chose, each by an opaque reference, and the person's requests to the organization's administrators. Sent whole by the person's Fabric with the credential the organization's server issued it for that person, each revision replacing the last; a revision with no items and no requests withdraws the plan. Never the plan's draft, its inventory or anything the person did not choose. docs/specification/membership.md#the-adaptation-plan.

revision.description: Counts up from 1; the server keeps the newest it accepted.

items.description: What the person chose to bring, each once by its ref (FAC-SEM-153).

requests.description: The person's requests to the organization's administrators, each id once (FAC-SEM-153).

ref.description: An opaque reference the person's Fabric draws at random for an item and this organization: never derived from a name, path or id of the person's estate, never reused for another organization (DEC-0128), and kept for that item in every later revision to this organization, a withdrawal included.

label.description: A name the person typed for the organization; Fabric never fills it from the estate.

requestId.description: The request's id within the plan, drawn at random by the person's Fabric for this organization and kept while the request stands.

itemRef.description: The item this request is for, one of the plan's items (FAC-SEM-153).

resource.description: access: the organization's own name of the account, environment or credential asked for, typed by the person.

note.description: access: why, typed by the person; never filled from the estate.

amountUsd.description: spend: the amount asked for, in US dollars.

period.description: spend: once, or each calendar month.

purpose.description: spend: what it is for, typed by the person; never filled from the estate.

role.description: role: the member list's role asked for (org-authority/1). owner is never asked for and member is the role the person already holds, so admin is the only role a request names.
